is_spam.instructions: Is `ticket.text` automated spam or nonsense rather than a message from a real customer?

criteria.true: Bulk promotion, phishing, gibberish, or bot output
criteria.false: A real person asking for help, even if rude or brief

criteria.billing: Charges, refunds, invoices, payment failures, payouts
criteria.technical: Bugs, outages, errors, integrations, login problems
criteria.sales: Pricing questions, upgrades, new accounts, quotes
criteria.none_of_these: None of the teams above clearly fits

urgency.instructions: How urgent is `ticket.text` for the customer's business?
criteria: Question or request with no time pressure
Inconvenience; the customer can keep working
Part of the customer's business is blocked or money is delayed
The customer's business is stopped or money is being lost right now
